definitions.gloss: reverse order; inverted sequence; backward order
definitions.explanation: An arrangement or sequence that is the opposite of the usual or expected order. Used when describing things presented from last to first, from newest to oldest, or from Z to A.

examples.japanese: {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}に{並|なら}べる。
アルファベットの{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}で{表示|ひょうじ}する。
ファイルを{日付|ひづけ}の{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}に{並|なら}べ{替|か}えたら、{一番|いちばん}{新|あたら}しいものが{上|うえ}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: When I re-sorted the files in reverse chronological order, the newest one appeared at the top.

notes:
Combines {逆|ぎゃく} (reverse, opposite) and {順|じゅん} (order, sequence). A clean compound where the two characters have opposite meanings, producing a word that means the inversion of the normal order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}に{並|なら}べる: to arrange in reverse order
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}で{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display in reverse order
- {時系列|じけいれつ}の{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}: reverse chronological order
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}ソート: reverse sort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}: order, turn — the normal order or sequence
- {逆|ぎゃく}: reverse, opposite — broader; can describe any reversal, not just of sequence
- {降順|こうじゅん}: descending order — a technical term (e.g., in databases), while {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん} is more general
- {昇順|しょうじゅん}: ascending order — the opposite of {降順|こうじゅん}
